title: FastAPI application setup with CORS, health check, and graceful shutdown
description: Implement app.py creating a FastAPI application configured with CORS middleware, lifespan lifecycle for camera/service cleanup, and health status endpoint GET /api/health.
acceptanceCriteria: FastAPI app initializes cleanly with configured CORS for localhost development
GET /api/health returns 200 with status 'ok', version, and subsystem health indicators
Application lifecycle cleanly closes background services, camera captures, and log streams on shutdown
Unit tests verify health endpoint response and application startup/shutdown events

steps.description: Create FastAPI app skeleton in app.py
steps.details: Create app.py instantiating FastAPI app with title 'DrishtiDrive AI', version '1.2.0', and CORSMiddleware.
Implement lifespan async context manager to initialize CameraService, StateMachine, AlertManager, EventLogger on startup, and gracefully stop them on shutdown.
Return JSON containing {'status': 'ok', 'app': 'DrishtiDrive AI', 'version': '1.2.0', 'uptime': seconds, 'camera_status': camera_service.status}.
Create tests/test_api_health.py using fastapi.testclient.TestClient to verify /api/health returns 200 and expected JSON structure.

technicalNotes: Keep app.py focused as the API router and lifecycle coordinator under 250 lines.
Ensure graceful shutdown prevents camera device locking.
